input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII caps only Licensor's liability, and does so at one half of all amounts we have paid — well below 6 months' fees on any reading — while our liability is left entirely uncapped (and is expanded by the one-way indemnity in Article XII and the exculpations in Article II). That is walk-away territory on two counts (one-sided cap; Vendor cap below 6 months' fees), so it fails the fallback. We have taken the fallback: the cap in (b) is now mutual and set at fees paid by Licensee in the 12 months preceding the claim, with a new (d) placing indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap. We have not pushed to the preferred position here (USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable", mutual consequential-damages exclusion in (a), and data protection/fraud/IP carve-outs), which remains available if Licensor prefers to trade.

proposal.summary: Make the Article XIII cap mutual and set it at 12 months' fees, and place indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap currently protects only Licensor and is set at one half of all amounts paid, leaving us fully exposed; we have made it mutual at 12 months' fees, which is our fallback position. We have also placed indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY LICENSEE TO LICENSOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

ops.text: THE LIMITATION IN SECTION (b) ABOVE SHALL NOT APPLY TO, AND EACH PARTY'S LIABILITY SHALL BE UNCAPPED FOR, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, AND ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
